slots.name: executive representation
slots.sentence: Even though the percentage of East German executives in the highest federal agencies has risen from 13.9% in 2022 to 16.3% today, Kaiser says, "The further up the management ladder you go, the lower the percentage of East Germans you find."

slots.name: sector representation share
slots.sentence: With just under 20%, East Germans are significantly underrepresented in all sectors relative to their share of the population.
